shows.title: শহীদ
shows.tagline: The men and women who gave everything for freedom.
shows.description: A Bengali historical drama series that brings the lives and final days of Bengal’s revolutionaries to the screen — Khudiram Bose, Jatindra Nath Das, Pritilata Waddedar, Prafulla Chaki and Bina Das — with one story in every episode.

shows.tagline: A stand-up comedy show. 100% faltu guaranteed.
shows.description: Bengali stand-up comedy from ADDABAAZ, featuring Subhadip Ghosh, Vaskar Manna, Pramit Mitra and Anmitra Sarkar — local jokes, local trains, local chaos.
